task_decomposition: Planner: Extract the frozen evidence boundaries, enumerate allowed versus forbidden claim areas, and map each submitted claim C1-C6 to the evidence it depends on.

Critic: Check each mapped claim for overreach, especially production deployment, packet-capture benchmarking, public-chain benchmarking, full media-plane QoE validation, and unimplemented six-variant ablation assertions.
Recovery: Rewrite any unsafe or unsupported claims into evidence-bounded alternatives using only the frozen local n8n, Stage D-real, and Stage E/F model-assisted evidence descriptions.

Verifier: Confirm that final classifications and rewrites remain consistent with the frozen evidence: 156 local artifact runs before the extension, 120 passed Stage D-real records across three variants and four profiles, and Stage E/F inter-model claim-boundary checking around local evidence.
success_criteria: C1 is classified as supported by the frozen evidence.
C2 is classified as supported by the frozen evidence.
C3 is classified as forbidden or unsupported because production O-RAN deployment validation is explicitly excluded.
C4 is classified as forbidden or unsupported because a 240-run six-variant ablation is explicitly excluded.
C5 is classified as supported if phrased as inter-model communication or claim-boundary checking around local evidence.
C6 is classified as forbidden or unsupported because packet-capture network-impairment benchmarking is explicitly excluded.

No final claim exceeds local workflow repeatability, local evidence-grounded orchestration, executable baseline comparison, profile-labelled orchestration robustness, or inter-model claim-boundary checking.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The artifact supports local evidence-grounded orchestration claims, including 156 executed local n8n evidence runs before the Stage E/F extension and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results constitute a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The evaluation validates public-chain performance or full media-plane QoE.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Critic agent: review C1-C6 against the frozen evidence and explicitly mark each as supported, unsupported, or forbidden, without introducing any claims beyond the allowed local evidence-grounded scope.
